notes: Hashes are md5 over the RAW pixel buffer (Image.GetData()), never over the saved PNG.
A GPU or driver change legitimately moves every hash at once; the gpu field above is what these were captured on. Regenerate after a driver update, and say so in the commit message.
A landed visual change updates this file in the SAME commit and names the shots it moved. An unexplained flip is a stop-the-line finding, not a regeneration.

exercises = what the shot covers TODAY, one sentence under 250 chars. REWRITE it on a re-pin, never append: no past-change deltas, no item ids, no dates. A commit hook enforces this. History is git log -p on this file; reasoning is the commit message.
The runner appends --screenshot=<abs path> and --log-file=<abs path>; everything else is the args below verbatim.

shots.name: c1-waterfall
shots.exercises: UV scroll on the falls sheet, the mist puffer, and the alpha-textured spray under the zone's world light; frame-sensitive 1.28 % at 120 vs 121.

shots.name: c1b-night-sea
shots.exercises: night lighting, skydome, islands, coastline sheets dimmed by the 0.426 world light like every lit surface, the ambient cloud-puff field; static at 120 vs 121, 0.13 % at 120 vs 360 (puff drift).

shots.name: c1c-rain
shots.exercises: rain precipitation (seeded field on the sim clock), cloud deck, heavy fog; frame-sensitive 2.50 %.

shots.name: c2-city
shots.exercises: C2's solid 3D city blocks, billboard clutter, backlot geometry, daylight fog, and the harbour wake spray the boat start anims emit, alpha sprites lit like the rest; near-static, 51 px at 120 vs 121.

shots.name: c2b-rain
shots.exercises: rain over open water — the surface A3 measured at 4.75 % unpinned; frame-sensitive 3.47 %.

shots.name: c3-island
shots.exercises: coastline, surf edge and open water at close range, the blended surf sheets taking the world light with the water; static, 9 px at 120 vs 360, so it proves geometry and shading, not the clock.

shots.name: c4-snow
shots.exercises: snow precipitation plus the chapter carrying 6 UV-scroll models; frame-sensitive 3.74 %, the largest of the freecam set.

shots.name: c5-city-night
shots.exercises: the night city: LIGHT_STATE point lights packed into csky_light_data, lit window skins, moon and stars; static, 11 px at 120 vs 360.

shots.name: viewer-bhawk
shots.exercises: one aircraft built and painted: PlaneBuilder with the cockpit interior subtree the viewer lab builds, the default Fortune Hunters livery and decals, the orbit camera's framing, the launcher-default light; static by construction, 0 px at 30 vs 360.

shots.name: empty-stage
shots.exercises: Synthetic no-gamez flight: code-drawn grid, default sky and sun, quaternion attitude integration, chase camera and HUD; frame-sensitive 12.21 %, and still renders with extracted/ absent.

shots.name: c1-flight
shots.exercises: Held pitch-and-roll flight: quaternion physical rates, chase camera, default livery, prop and surface animators, gauges, compass, pipper, exhaust, SpeedCue, the plane under the zone's SUNLIGHT over a world-lit C1; frame-sensitive.

shots.name: c1-destroy-effects
shots.exercises: Neutral-control player flight beside a killed ap_radiotwr: great_balls_of_fire on the world-effects stage riding its death site, flight-state-dependent SpeedCue, seeded puffer placement, world-lit alpha scenery; frame-sensitive.

shots.name: c1-crash
shots.exercises: player_crash_default after five flight steps: corrected pre-crash attitude, crash rig and airframe, moving distance puffers, ranged tumble, vector-form pieces, flydirt delta, pooled repeat calls, over world-lit C1 scenery.

shots.name: c1-debris-rest
shots.exercises: the two-ray column ground-contact tier: a killed hangar's flung debris tested against terrain, one piece resting with its landing's own spark puffer as the visible signal, over C1 ground and cutouts under one world light.

shots.name: c1-targeting-hud
shots.exercises: Targeting a live AI in flight: its quaternion-driven pose and crewed rear turret feed fixed antialiased in-range brackets, the label below the plane, --debug-markers identity/health text, world-lit C1 beneath; frame-sensitive 48.18 %.

shots.name: c1-ai-wreck
shots.exercises: A shot-down AI three seconds after the kill: quaternion flight state under frozen commands, the target's antialiased brackets, the handover fireball inheriting the hull's velocity, the LOW ALT lamp inside its 60 m gate, world-lit C1.

shots.name: campaign-4p-grid
shots.exercises: Four humans launch a co-op campaign mission abreast on StartGrid: four render targets, HUDs and cockpit gauges, no cutscene collapsing the panes, the C1 world under its light in every pane; frame-sensitive 73.79%.

shots.name: campaign-intro-fill
shots.exercises: A campaign mission's intro cutscene fills the whole window at four human players: one pane at the full rect, letterbox bars, the rest hidden with no gutter, the world-lit C1 scene behind; frame-sensitive 3.89%.

shots.name: menu-original-flag
shots.exercises: The Original top level over its decoded layout: the CrimFlag movie decoded from the install's own MPEG-1 and drawn as the backmost layer at the row's 250 percent, with the logo, button frame and plaques over it.

shots.name: menu-original-options-flag
shots.exercises: The Options screen over the decoded Preferences chrome with the same movie running under it: the page's four doors, its title and descriptions, and the flag at the layout row's own corner and scale.
